tracks.title: Baby What You Want Me To Do

physical: Pressed by Decca Record Co. Ltd., Pressing Plant, UK.

notes.text:
Original UK release in matt gatefold cover, on pink MCA Records labels.
Poly-lined [blue 'STEREO' squares] standard company inner sleeve with record handling instructions, 'Made In England R.S.'

. 
First catalogue number on cover, 2nd (Int. No.) in parentheses on cover & labels.

"Live Dates" was recorded during the latter part of June 1973 at the following venues:
• Croydon - Fairfield Hall: A1, D2.
• Newcastle - City Hall: A2, A3, C2.
• Reading - University: B1, B2, C1, C3, D1.
• Portsmouth - Guildhall: B3.
Recorded On: The Rolling Stones 16 track mobile.
Re-mixed At: Olympic Studios London.

℗ © 1973, The Decca Record Company Limited, London. [cover]
℗ 1973 MCA Records Inc.

B1 appears on cover as "Rock 'n Roll Widow", but as "Rock And Roll Widow" on label.
C1 appears on cover as "The Pilgrim", but as "Pilgrim" on label.
C2 appears on cover as "Blowin Free", but as "Blowin' Free" on label.
C3 appears on cover inside as "Jailbait", but as "Jail Bait" on cover outside & label.
D1 appears on cover inside as "Lady Whisky", but as "Lady Whiskey" on cover outside & label.

Sleeve printed in England by Robert Stace.
Made in England
MCA Records, Decca House, 9 Albert Embankment, London SE1 7SW
Manufactured in Great Britain by The Decca Record Company Limited, Licensed by MCA Records Inc., Universal City, California, U.S.A.
Made In England • The Decca Record Co. Ltd.

Publishing:
• Miles Music/Feldman - A1 to A3, B1, B2.
• Tollie Music - B3.
• Feldman Music/Miles Music - C1 to C3.
• Miles Music - D1, D2.

Runouts are stamped.
